offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family detached homes and townhomes to homebuyers, mainly on lots it controls, and offers mortgage, title and insurance services to those buyers through its financial services subsidiaries.

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; title insurance; homeowners insurance brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, move-up and active adult homebuyers

end_markets.value: residential real estate; mortgage lending; title and insurance

revenue_model.value: product sales: home sales to buyers, including lot and home price; service fees: mortgage origination, title and insurance fees from homebuyers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: builds homes using subcontractors and purchased materials, sold to individual homebuyers; financial intermediary: originates mortgages and sells most loans to investors, earning fees from homebuyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, Northeast and Southeast states, including Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, North Carolina and Florida

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding under several brands, plus mortgage banking, title and insurance services for homebuyers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales staff at communities selling to individual homebuyers; own locations: model homes and sales offices in its communities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mortgage lending licenses and consumer lending rules such as RESPA and TILA enforced by CFPB and states, local building codes and zoning
